map.每日饮水量计算器 使用指南: Daily Water Intake Calculator — User Guide
map.工具按体重与活动生成约 9 个时段：06:30 起床空腹 310ml、08:00: The tool generates about 9 time slots from weight and activity: 06:30 on waking, fasting, 310ml; 08:00 after breakfast, 260ml; 10:00 work break, 260ml; 11:30 before lunch, 200ml; 13:30…
map.按体重给基础饮水量：基础需求通常按体重估算（约 30-35 ml/kg/天），再: Base water intake by weight: baseline need is estimated from body weight (about 30-35 ml/kg/day), then raised for exercise, temperature, pregnancy and lactation to get a daily total target.
map.拆分到全天分次饮用：把总量分配到起床后、三餐前后、上下午、睡前等时段，每段时间给: Split across the day: distribute the total into waking, around meals, morning/afternoon and before bed, giving a suggested amount per slot to avoid gulping at once and frequent night-time bathroom trips.
map.运动 / 高温额外补充：运动出汗或高温环境时追加补给（如每运动 30 分钟 +1: Extra for exercise/heat: add intake when sweating or in hot environments (e.g. +150-250ml per 30 minutes of exercise) to stay hydrated without overloading the gut.

map.心肾疾病、心衰等需限水人群请遵医嘱，不要盲目多饮: People with heart/kidney disease or heart failure who must limit fluid should follow medical advice and not drink excessively on their own
map.一定要喝到推荐量吗？: Must I drink up to the recommended amount?
map.推荐量是参考，实际以「口渴即喝、尿色淡黄」为准。心肾疾病、心衰等需限水人群请遵医: The recommendation is a reference; in practice go by 'drink when thirsty, pale-yellow urine'. People with heart/kidney disease or heart failure who must limit fluid should follow medical advice and not drink excessively.
map.茶、咖啡、汤算不算？: Do tea, coffee and soup count?
map.算一部分。茶咖含咖啡因有轻微利尿，但总体仍贡献水分；汤粥水分也可计入。完全靠咖啡: They count partly. Caffeine in tea and coffee has a mild diuretic effect but they still contribute water overall; water in soups and porridges also counts. Replacing all plain water with coffee is not recommended—plain water should stay the main source.
